hypotheses.name: Immune H1 persistence survives degree-preserving geodesic rewiring null
hypotheses.method: immune-only full-layer split screen with 3 seeds, 180 genes/test, PCA(14), H1 lifetime sum, feature-shuffle (20 draws) and degree-preserving kNN rewiring geodesic null (8 draws), Fisher combined across seeds
hypotheses.result_value: 0/24 significant; mean layer delta source=-140.519, target=-129.702
hypotheses.next_action: Recalibrate null by comparing geodesic-observed vs rewired-geodesic null to control metric-scale mismatch.
